anomalies.observed: The net named USBC_D_N contains the USB-C receptacle D- pins (J3 A7 and B7) and U25 pin 4 (I/O2), but it is also the board ground net: it contains every Module1 GND pin, the ground side of essentially every decoupling capacitor (C1.2, C2.2, C3.2, ...), the ground pins of U1/U2/U8/U9/U10/U11/U13/U14/U15/U17/U18/U19/U20/U21/U22/U23/U24/U25/U26/U27/U28/U29/U30/U31/U32/U33/U34/U35/U36, the shield of J3 (S1), etc. So the USB-C D- line is tied directly to GND.
anomalies.expected: USBC_D_N should be an isolated net carrying only the USB-C D- line (J3 A7/B7 and the U25 I/O2 pin that faces the connector), with no connection to the board ground net. The D+ side (net USBC_D_P) is correctly kept separate, so the D- side should be too.
anomalies.impact: The USB-C D- conductor is shorted to ground, so the USB-C data pair is broken (D+ still routes through U25/U24, but D- is clamped to 0 V). USB-C data communication (and any USB device/host function that depends on the D- line) will not work; only VBUS power delivery is unaffected.

anomalies.observed: R36 is placed across the rectified Ethernet-power rails (VOUTP to VOUTN). Its value field is "24k" and the SPICE deck models it as 24k, but its description field reads "... ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor ..." and its MPN is FRC0805J240TSD (a 24 Ω, 5 % part). The value, description and MPN do not agree.
anomalies.expected: The value, description and MPN of a two-terminal passive should all describe the same part. For a bleeder/divider element across a rail that can reach tens of volts, 24 kΩ is the plausible value, so the description/MPN (24 Ω) are the inconsistent fields.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the BOM/assembly follows the MPN or description, a 24 Ω resistor is fitted across VOUTP/VOUTN instead of 24 kΩ, which would heavily load (and likely damage) the Ethernet-derived power rail; if the value field is followed, the board is correct but the BOM metadata is wrong.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a real anomaly: the USB-C D- line (net USBC_D_N, J3 A7/B7 and U25 pin 4) is merged with the board ground net, shorting USB-C D- to GND. A secondary metadata inconsistency exists on R36 (value 24k vs description/MPN 24Ω).
